SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   D. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   B. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   D. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

9. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   D. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   B. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   D. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

15. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   C. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Exploration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
